inputs.name: ticks

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

device.name: StrideSim ANYmal-D flat velocity tracking (Isaac Lab task)

facts.text: The flat task inherits the rough task and changes the terrain to a plane, removes the height scanner and the height_scan observation and disables the terrain-level curriculum
The rough task sets the scene robot to ANYMAL_D_CFG
The velocity commands are sampled from -1.0 to 1.0 for linear x, linear y and angular z, with heading from -pi to pi
The policy action is a joint-position action over all joints with scale 0.5 and the default joint offset
The ANYmal-D articulation sample uses 12 joint positions, 12 joint velocities and 12 previous-action values, and its policy observation is a 235-value vector that includes a height scan
The flat task removes the height_scan observation term

In the base configuration, the policy observation terms are base linear velocity, base angular velocity, projected gravity, velocity commands, joint positions, joint velocities, the last action and the height scan
The policy observation terms are concatenated into one array and observation corruption is enabled in the base configuration
The simulation advances by 0.005 s per physics step, the control decimation is 4 and an episode is 20.0 s long
The flat task is registered as Template-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-Anymal-D-v0 with the external entry point omni.isaac.lab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv and the AnymalDFlatEnvCfg config
The upstream project requires Isaac Sim 4.0.0 and Isaac Lab v1.0.0

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the fake's command draw and the kinematic update is deterministic, so one seed and action sequence repeat a trajectory; the upstream Isaac Lab and PhysX random streams are not used and no trajectory was compared with the upstream environment

gaps: kinematic model: no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuator, sensor, terrain or noise model; the fake integrates a base velocity directly from the action

the fake uses the flat task's 12 action values and 48 observation values (the 235-value ANYmal-D sample observation without its height scan; flat_env_cfg.py:21), but the values are synthetic: joint positions, joint velocities and the previous action are placeholders, projected gravity is fixed, the base pose is not observed and the action space is unbounded because the real bound is outside the clone
the upstream simulator needs Isaac Sim 4.0.0 and Isaac Lab v1.0.0 with a GPU (README.md:30-32) and was not run; no trajectory was compared with it
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
the height scan, rough terrain, contacts, push events, actuator dynamics and PhysX physics are not modelled; the rough task's 235-value observation is not served
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state stays readable
